claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md, RANK-BRIDGE.md) returns scalar s in 1..r-1 from T=[s]P0 (ignoring auxiliary powers A_2..A_n, valid for all 1 <= n < r, evaluated at scoring n = 2^20 = 1048576) via g=e(P0,Q0), z=e(T,Q0)=g^s with fresh-coin boot randomization with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1, H1', H-EA, H2, H3, H-R, H-SM, H4, H4u, H-X and reached-ideal ensemble H5 (explicitly including de Bruijn local-density correction, closed-form 1D/2D 4-prime 62-bit NTT, fixed-instance H3 4-param hard-capped LA, H-R/H-X rank bridge with live unplanted 4-SM BW + 1D-kernel Hankel+Horner + zero-loss repurge_stack verification, i.i.d. single-cell D_skew=2^21 exact-LLL boot with RET_BOOT=0.50, exact seeded peeling closure h=0.256845 (post_peel_cols_lost=0), deterministic hard per-node survivor cap S_cap=ceil(2.0*cells*(sv+pr)) (ZERO H-EA in descent work!), NB(1.5) reached-ideal H5 with B_max=10 strictly i.i.d. root-only fresh-e_j boot retries (k=1 inside DAG, exact Wald work) behind a hard combined-log meter t=2^122.2 (Markov <= 0.000173) with unconditional Boole union bound, multi-factor ECM loops, and 100-round MR), at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64) x 10 x (2^111.1199619594+2^66) < 2^113.083728980200 batched affine G1 additions (C=2,000; 1 core unit = 10 G1 units): an expectation over the challenge and fresh coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every single run. A run gate (u < K = 7195690914002267591, (K/2^64) x 0.999797 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.999797 (unconditional Boole union bound; metered row sum <= 2^125.522346090588 units with combined-log meter t=2^122.2). Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.
